doc.title: Sol Yaged interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 29, 2000

title: Playing Make Believe and Moonglow
summary: Monk requests Moonglow; Sol plays it.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: You’re not. I’m going to let my friend Tim get some supper, but could you honor me with a rendition of “Moonglow?” It’s always one of my favorites.
It would be my pleasure. That was another song I played going to Atlantic City. I’m serious.
When you got to the M’s.

An M. I played a song before that, [Sol plays]. You remember that song? “Make Believe.” [Sol plays]. That was from “Roberta.” It was a song written by Jerome Kern. That was another song I did. Here’s “Moonglow” for you. Thank you. [Sol plays].
